Description

Test key subsystems of QB50. INMS Payload from MSSL, UK. QB50 ADCS system from SSC, UK. Thermocouple experiment from VKI, Belgium. AMSAT-NL 435/145 MHz linear transponder (FUNcube-3) from AMSAT-NL, The Netherlands.
